issues.issue: Whether the RAD reasonably found no nexus to a Convention ground (political opinion) in the land dispute
issues.applicant_position: RAD failed to analyse fear of persecution as more than a land dispute, given cousin's political connections and threats.
issues.result_text: No reviewable error; RAD understood the political connections but found corruption, not persecution based on political opinion.

issues.issue: Whether the RAD reasonably expected the applicants to sell land to avoid harm
issues.applicant_position: Land is needed for basic income, so requiring its sale is unreasonable; cites exceptions in case law.
issues.result_text: Evidence did not show dependence on the land for income; family owns other land, so no error.
